note: ROUND 2 EVAL wording, authored 2026-10-03 after round 1; new families, names, nouns. Each family gives an ADD and a SUB question over x (written first) and y. ADD gold = x+y. SUB gold = x-y with x>y.

families.add: {name} loaded {x} {noun} into one crate and {y} {noun} into another crate. Together, how many {noun} are in the two crates?
families.sub: {name} loaded {x} {noun} into one crate and {y} {noun} into another crate. By how many does the first crate's count exceed the second crate's count?

families.add: The museum displayed {x} {noun} in the east hall and {y} {noun} in the west hall. Find the combined number of {noun} on display.
families.sub: The museum displayed {x} {noun} in the east hall and {y} {noun} in the west hall. Find how many {noun} the east hall has above the west hall.

families.add: {name} collected {x} {noun}, and {name2} collected {y} {noun}. If they pool their {noun}, how many will they have?
families.sub: {name} collected {x} {noun}, and {name2} collected {y} {noun}. How many more {noun} would {name2} need to match {name}?

families.add: A truck dropped off {x} {noun} on Friday and {y} {noun} on Saturday. What is the sum of the {noun} delivered on both days?
families.sub: A truck dropped off {x} {noun} on Friday and {y} {noun} on Saturday. What is the gap between Friday's delivery and Saturday's delivery?

families.add: In one classroom there are {x} {noun}, and in the room next door there are {y} {noun}. What is the grand total of {noun} in both rooms?
families.sub: In one classroom there are {x} {noun}, and in the room next door there are {y} {noun}. By how many are the {noun} in the first room more numerous than those next door?

families.add: During a quiz, {name} answered {x} questions correctly in part one and {y} questions correctly in part two. How many correct answers did {name} give in the whole quiz?
families.sub: During a quiz, {name} answered {x} questions correctly in part one and {y} questions correctly in part two. By how many does the part-one score exceed the part-two score?
